rationale.CVE-2026-107496: PostgreSQL16.15/libpq/OpenLDAP use ordinary TLS rather than OpenSSL QUIC; pgcrypto exposes its reviewed cipher whitelist (not AES-GCM-SIV) and PGP RSA/ElGamal, not CMS encryption. The complete native image inventory, binary/extension hashes, startup/init-directory state, OpenSSL configuration/engine/provider directories and fixed deployment sources are bound. Final deployment separately rejects changes to the reviewed live TLS/preload/extension/native-function catalog or role/database library overrides. Reviewed excluded path: CMS encryption with untrusted EC recipient certificates.
